 O R D E R
Issue notice, returnable in the month of November 2023.

including dasti.

In the meanwhile, the petitioner  Ganga Singh Bhadoria shall appear before the
trial court
and he shall not be taken into custody till the next date of hearing.

opennyai_summary.facts:
It is submitted that that the respondent - Central Bureau of Investigation upon investigation had filed a closure report against the petitioner  Ganga Singh Bhadoria.
Further, Ramveer Sharma is a close relative of the accused in the case relating to murder of the petitioners son.
Thus, the assertion that the petitioner - Ganga Singh Bhadoria and Ramveer Sharma were associated is not correct.
